reason: The premise suggests a causal relationship between high child labor rates in Asia and child labor issues in Sub-Saharan Africa, which contradicts the factual nature of the data indicating that child labor issues are primarily a concern in Sub-Saharan Africa itself, not caused by conditions in Asia.
refined_position: Causal Misattribution - The premise incorrectly attributes the cause of child labor issues in Sub-Saharan Africa to high child labor rates in Asia, despite evidence indicating that these issues are primarily localized to Sub-Saharan Africa.
